evidence.significance: Initiates refresh on any 401 response from protected endpoints
refreshSession() returns false when POST /auth/refresh is not OK (4xx/5xx)
logout() called immediately when refreshSession() returns false
Token reuse detected during rotate() throws exception → returns 401 to client
Rejects valid JWT with 401 if token family was revoked during concurrent refresh — this is the direct cause of user being logged out even when a winning tab got 200
